headline: Gigabyte Plans to Spend NT$4.5 Billion to Acquire 82% Stake in Baile to Expand Medical Device Distribution
summary: Gigabyte plans to buy Midas Health for about US$140 million through subsidiary Hongkang Holdings, indirectly gaining an 82.35% stake in Baile Medical. Baile holds distribution channels in over 100 countries.
why: Gigabyte is a Taiwanese memory and hardware distributor, and this deal would expand it into medical device distribution. Acquisitions like this shift a company's revenue mix and balance sheet.
